Inderveer Alias Boby --Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others
--Respondents
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
Hon'ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Sri Bilal Ahmed, learned counsel for
petitioner.
2. Sri Amarendra Pratap Singh, learned
Additional Advocate General for the State of
Uttarakhand.
3. Sri Rahul Verma, learned counsel for
respondent No. 3.
4. Petitioner alleges that respondent Nos. 5 to
8 have made encroachments over water-body
land. By means of this writ petition, he has sought
the following reliefs:-
"a) Issue a writ order or direction in the
nature of Mandamus directing the
respondents no. 1 to 2 to take immediate
action for removing the encroachment
done by respondent no. 3 to 8 over the
land depicted by Village
MohammadpurJat, Post Gurukul Narsan
Tehsil Roorkee District Haridwar which
is a public property and is entered as
"Pond" in the revenue record
b) Issue a writ order or direction in the
nature of Mandamus directing the
respondents no. 1 to 4 to take suitable
action against the
encroachers/respondent no. 3 to 8 who
have made illegal encroachment over
Khasra No. 383 () measuring 0.7940
hectares Village MohammadpurJat, Post
GurukulNarsan Tehsil Roorkee District
Haridwarw Which is a public property

UKHC010180672026
2026:UHC:9531-DB
and is entered as Pond" in the revenue
record."
5. Sri Rahul Verma, learned counsel for
respondent No. 3, however, submits that false
allegations are being made in the writ petition and
there is no encroachment over the water-body
land.
6. We are not inclined to go into the factual
dispute as sought to be raised by petitioner,
however, the writ petition is disposed of with
liberty to petitioner to make representation to
District Magistrate, Haridwar. If petitioner makes
representation within two weeks, District
Magistrate shall, first, hold inquiry as to whether
the petitioner has made any encroachment over
government land or water-body land. If it is
found that petitioner has not made any
encroachment over government or water-body
land, District Magistrate shall proceed to consider
the issue raised by petitioner in his representation,
and if any encroachment is found over water-body
land, as alleged by petitioner, the same shall be
removed as per law after hearing the persons,
whose encroachment is over such land. It is,
however, made clear that if petitioner is found to
have encroached on government or water-body
land, District Magistrate shall first remove
encroachment of petitioner from the said land.
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.)
